messages:
alex: CI red on integrations suite — hosted API tests failing (auth + streaming + tool-calls). failing test: tests/integration/test_tool_stream_auth.py::test_hosted_toolcall_streaming. link: https://ci.redwood/internal/build/12345

morgan: saw that. any logs?

alex: pasting relevant snippet:```
E   requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://hosted-staging.redwood/api/token/exchange
401: invalid_client
```

priya: also seeing schema assertion in the toolcall path:```
E   AssertionError: response missing required key 'tools' (received keys: ['choices', 'usage'])
```

sam: hmm looks like two symptoms — token exchange 401 + missing tools in streaming response. could be a regression from last week's auth caching change (PR #2345).

kai: @alex can you repro locally against hosted-staging? quick curl to show headers and body would help.

alex: repro steps I ran:```
HOSTED_URL=https://hosted-staging.redwood
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=staging-xxxxx
curl -v "$HOSTED_URL/v1/chat/stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-claude-like","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"call tool"}],"stream":true,"tools":[{"name":"echo","schema_version":1}]}'
```

alex: output shows 401 during token handshake, then client aborts. But when I run test-suite locally with `HOSTED_EMU=true` it passes.

morgan: ci-bot: please rerun build 12345 (shard=hosted-integ).

ci-bot: Rerun requested by morgan. Build 12345 -> 12345.1 queued.

ci-bot: Build 12345.1 started on runner hosted-integ-09.

ci-bot: Build 12345.1 finished — status: FAIL. Same test failing.

priya: can someone bisect? suspect commit range: 2d7f..a9c4 (auth-cache changes). If bisecting is costly, try disabling the token cache in config and rerun.

sam: quick check — I ran the failing test pointing to hosted-staging but with cache disabled (ENV: REDWOOD_AUTH_CACHE=0) and it passed once, failed again twice. flaky.

kai: PR #2345 touched token refresh + streaming auth header generation. maybe edge-case when tool-call handshake includes extra Content-Type.

alex: stacktrace from server side (from hosted-staging logs):```
ERROR handler: token_exchange failed: oauth: invalid_client (client_id missing)
stack: /srv/handlers/auth.go:142
```

morgan: could be a header mutation in our streaming proxy (eng-infra change last week). Eng-infra, any chance a proxy patch stripped a header? @eng-infra (ping)

sam: quick triage idea — rollback proxy patch in staging for a couple hours and rerun CI. I can make a canary if someone approves.

priya: ok let's do an A/B: sam rollback proxy on hosted-staging, alex rerun failing test. If green -> proxy. If still red -> auth-service or token cache.

alex: opening bisect issue and will attach logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/integration-tests/issues/789 (PR list + logs). I'm going to run a focused bisect across commits that touched auth/proxy.

sam: started rollback (canary) on hosted-staging now. deploy-bot: will post when done.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback of proxy version 2.13.4 -> 2.13.2 started on hosted-staging.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback complete on runner hosted-staging-17.

alex: rerunning the single integration test against staging now.

ci-bot: Triggered one-off job: hosted-integ-single 12345.repro.

ci-bot: hosted-integ-single 12345.repro finished — status: PASS. :tada:

morgan: ok that's a strong signal pointing to proxy patch. great catch.

priya: next steps: 1) revert proxy change in main branch (or patch to preserve auth header), 2) run full integrations, 3) monitor canary. Can someone own the PR?

sam: I'll open the revert PR and include failing logs + minimal test. PR draft coming.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll keep bisect issue updated. If revert lands, can we force-run the full matrix tomorrow morning?

morgan: yes schedule run for 06:00 PT. I'll queue it.

kai: note for postmortem: add a test that asserts the proxy preserves X-Token-Meta header during streaming/toolcall handshakes.

priya: ack. adding to integration-tests backlog.

alex: closing loop — triage suggests proxy regression. opener: sam will submit revert PR; alex will validate; morgan will schedule full run. thanks :thumbsup:

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/456 — revert auth header change.

ci-bot: CI queued for PR 456.

alex: ping when green, I'll merge and kick the full suite.

morgan: noted. good teamwork. :rocket:
